name: The Market Bouquet
description: Whatever came in this morning at its best — roses, ranunculus, sweet pea — hand-tied and wrapped in tissue.
image_alt: A hand-tied bouquet of blush garden roses, white ranunculus, and sweet pea wrapped in tissue and tied with ribbon.

name: The Little Posy
description: A small jug's worth of cutting-garden flowers. For a bedside, a desk, or a thank-you.
image_alt: A small posy of cosmos, feverfew, cornflowers, and sweet pea in an old ceramic jug.

name: Parrot Tulips
description: An armful of ruffled parrot tulips, left to curve and open the way tulips want to.
image_alt: Red, flamed, and apricot parrot tulips curving out of a tall glass vase.

name: The Long Table
description: A low, spilling centerpiece in an aged brass compote, kept short enough to talk over.
image_alt: A low centerpiece of white roses, peach tulips, and trailing jasmine in a brass compote bowl.

name: The Dark Garden
description: Burgundy dahlias, black hellebores, and smoke bush in a bronze urn. Our most-asked-for piece.
image_alt: A tall arrangement of burgundy dahlias, dark roses, hellebores, and trailing amaranthus in a bronze urn.

name: In Quiet Remembrance
description: White roses, stock, and lisianthus with soft silver foliage, in a low stone vessel for the home or the service.
image_alt: A calm arrangement of white roses, lisianthus, stock, and silver foliage in a low stone vessel.
